criteria.reason: Front matter declares params method=merge, rounds=2; results merged, red; stops-on red; loop-on red; loop-via collect-findings, fix-findings, push, wait-ci; loop-rounds rounds. Loader test 'merge declares the red loop: rounds defaults to 2, loop keys load' passed (275/275).

Passing loader cases, each asserting the refusal message: loop-on not in stops-on, unknown loop-via, outward loop-via (must be outward: no), loop-declaring loop-via (declares a loop of its own), loop-rounds naming no param, and loop-rounds whose default is not a whole number.

Passing tests assert the owner step's loop {on: red, rounds: 2, body ids 5.1-5.4}, that the loop is stored in shipped.json, that the bound comes from the snapshot, and that a repeat body counts as listed.
Passing tests assert that body params copy the earlier listed step: format=md and bar=low, with the nearest earlier step winning inside a repeat.
Passing test: when a loop-via primitive is not listed before the owner, no loop is synthesized and red stops the run at the owner with 'recorded red; the run stops here'. No later step is handed out.
Three passing cases: rounds=0, merge inside a repeat, and an old snapshot with no loop. Each gets no loop and stops on red as today.
The sequence test, shown in it1-stuck-reason.txt and passing, hands out 5, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5: red moves to the first body step, the body runs in order, and the owner is handed out again.
Passing cases: wait-ci failed in round 1 hands out 5.1 again (the next round), and collect-findings clean hands the owner out again.
The full rounds=2 walk asserts 3 owner attempts and 2 body rounds, round 2 marked final, then stuck. The round-2 wait-ci failed variant also ends stuck.
Literal stuck reasons are asserted in passing tests: 'step 5 (kilo) loop ended after 2 rounds: step 5 (kilo) recorded red' and '... step 5.4 (wait-ci) recorded failed'.
The guide says a repeat makes rounds + 1 passes, while the merge loop's rounds=N is N body rounds and at most N + 1 merge attempts.

Three passing cases. laterNeeds counts the body only while a round is left, and laterNeedsOf adds the owner and the next round for body steps. status flags 5.1-5.4 as loop steps. authorization walks loop bodies.

Contract step 1 waits as wait-ci does (gh pr checks, Monitor, one rerun, flaky-ci record) on a head this step pushed now or on an earlier stopped attempt. It treats any head not recorded by wait-ci or collect-findings as unjudged, which covers the headRefOid-differs trigger. The seam merge-up red test runs a checks wait before any merge call.
The seam happy path (MERGEABLE and CLEAN: no merge-in, no push, gate none, gh pr merge called) passed. The contract leaves an already judged head unwaited.

No artifact proves it. The merge contract step 1 failed-branch text says a hand-merged PR goes on to step 2 and otherwise returns red with data { failed, flaky, head } before the custody gate, but 2 contract-wording tests in packages/core/contracts/ship-primitives.test.js fail against that text (they expect "then return `red`" and a line starting "`red`, with `data`: `{ failed, flaky, head }`"). There is also no seam test where a head merged by hand during the wait goes on to step 2.
Passing tests: merge runs the gate, then the pr-head check, then gh pr merge, then the merge link. The seam loop case records 'merge --match-head-commit <fixed head>' after the gate.

The seam case 'red head, loop fixes it, CI green: merge runs once on the fixed head' passed: the loop runs collect-findings, fix-findings, push and wait-ci, and gh pr merge is called once on the fixed head.
The seam case 'CI stays red until the bound is spent: stuck naming 2 rounds, gh pr merge never called' passed.
